source: Controlled multi-stage workflow in isolated Electron; DOM identity and frame measurements

cases.name: S01 collapsed reasoning exposes live content; same-line growth preserves node
S02 reasoning changes identity without replay or replacing the text node
S03 completed child tools remain one active stage with current command
S04 arriving prose ends stage and shows live response before completion
S05 completed answer retains its DOM while work folds, keyboard restores details
S06 a new turn reserves bounded answer space, consumed by a growing response
S07 upward reading is not stolen by streaming; explicit bottom resumes following
S08 opening tool output anchors the trigger, user wheel cancels compensation
S09 completed turn retains error outside folded history; narrow geometry stays bounded
